elements.element: Vendor defends and indemnifies Customer against third-party IP infringement claims (preferred)
elements.evidence: TrueLink shall defend and indemnify Client against any third-party claim alleging that the Interface, the Hosting Services or the Support Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right
new 12(c) runs only to "Client"; no affiliates named in the added clause

elements.element: Coverage for Vendor's breach of law (preferred)
elements.evidence: 12(b) covers only "any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations"; no breach-of-law head

elements.element: Coverage for data breach caused by Vendor (preferred)
elements.evidence: no data breach indemnity anywhere in Section 12

elements.element: Coverage for Vendor gross negligence/wilful misconduct (preferred)
elements.evidence: no reference to gross negligence or wilful misconduct
no notice, control of defence or cooperation mechanics added

elements.element: Customer indemnity limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law (preferred)
elements.evidence: 12(a) retains broad heads including "(i) any claim arising out of any breach by Client of this Agreement" and "(iv) injury or damage to person or property caused by a product, service, or information, whether or not defective"

TrueLink shall defend and indemnify Client against any third-party claim alleging that the Interface, the Hosting Services or the Support Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right
excluding any claim arising from Client's modifications of the foregoing
Client's combination of the foregoing with other products or services

elements.element: Remedy: procure right to continue use
elements.evidence: procure for Client the right to continue using the affected item
if none of the foregoing is available, refund the fees paid for the affected item

elements.element: Vendor indemnity subject to super-cap of 3× annual fees
elements.evidence: TrueLink's total liability under this Section 12(c) shall not exceed 3x the annual fees paid by Client under this Agreement

reasons: The inserted Section 12(c) completes every atomic element of the fallback: a Vendor defend-and-indemnify obligation for third-party IP infringement claims, the three usual exclusions (Client modifications, combinations, specifications), all four remedies (procure, modify, replace, refund) and a 3× annual fees super-cap.

Preferred is not met: no coverage for Vendor breach of law, Vendor-caused data breach or gross negligence/wilful misconduct, no notice/control/cooperation procedure, no extension to Client affiliates, and the broad Client indemnity in 12(a) is not narrowed to Client content and Client's breach of law. Consistent with the locked fallback target, these are rationale notes rather than deviations.
Minimality holds: a single concise insertion addressing an absent IP indemnity, with no rewrite of 12(a) or 12(b) and no preferred-only heads or unnecessary boilerplate imported.

Intent preserved: existing Section 12(a) and 12(b) remain fully effective; the cap is expressly confined to Section 12(c), so it does not cut down any other Client remedy, and it uses existing defined terms (Interface, Hosting Services, Support Services) without creating a dangling mechanic.
